title: Module Scaffold Compiler
description: Compiles the module folder structure and boundary rules for a backend feature module. Enforces single public entrypoint, no circular cross-module imports, and no undeclared internal folders.

error_codes.MS001: module-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: name, capabilities[]
error_codes.MS002: Module public entrypoint (index.ts) missing or does not export module API
error_codes.MS003: Internal folder exists that was not declared in capabilities[]
error_codes.MS004: Cross-module import bypasses public entrypoint (imports internal file directly)
